description: Tactical number 006; the mapper recorded a 1987 build year. Displayed on the grounds of the Instytut Techniczny Wojsk Lotniczych at Fort Bema

Towed aerial target of 1956 built by the Instytut Techniczny Wojsk Lotniczych; documented on samolotypolskie.pl. Recorded as a drone because it is an unmanned towed target; it has no wing_type entry because it is not a conventional fixed-wing airframe
